info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Regulatory Reporting API
info.description: The Regulatory Reporting API provides secure access to generate and retrieve compliance reports essential for banking institutions. This API enables financial organizations to automate the reporting process, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include compliance officers, risk management teams, and financial analysts who need timely and accurate reporting mechanisms. By leveraging this API, institutions can enhance their operational efficiency and maintain compliance with industry regulations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the latest regulatory reporting data, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations. You can use this to get an overview or specific details regarding your compliance status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve compliance regulatory reporting information. It requires a JSON payload that specifies the necessary parameters to execute the GET request successfully.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the regulatory reporting data.
